reason: Replace the implementation inventory with an adaptable engineering blueprint while preserving the researched authority, evidence, and failure limits. Old figure and active review records archived in book/editorial/appendix-a-blueprints-20261119/before.
links_and_groups: Flexible engineering judgment selects intended calls. A typed call contract is checked by parity against the current authoritative dependency map. That map and environment-specific deployment identities feed deterministic grant derivation, a concrete grant plan, application, and per-grant results. Installed IAM bindings govern invocation at a separate runtime boundary. Service-name correspondence is not an IAM check. Moving model authority requires a separate consumer migration.
